_doc: Wording for County Profiles change reports. `sourceNames` names a source in a vintage change where its snapshot label is ambiguous (both BEA entries share one label). Read by scripts/county-profiles/snapshot-diff.js, so the data PR and the site use the same names.

sourceNames.qcew-wages: BLS QCEW, marine wages comparison year
sourceNames.qcew-total-wages: BLS QCEW, total economy wages comparison year
